entries.ca191870718dec37: This is the only reportable segment: it accepts orders and print data over the internet, prints and processes them at its own factories, and ships them to customers. It keeps costs down by reducing the number of plates through "gang printing", which places the complete data submitted by customers for multiple orders together on 1 plate. It produces at the Tokyo Nishi Factory (Uenohara, Yamanashi) and the Kyushu Factory (Aira, Kagoshima), and revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥9,118 million.
